notes.title: Update 1.0.2022.45
notes.content:
Minor Update:
Reduced the time spent in combat per target
Added random spawn for additional monsters in various locations in the Dungeon
Increased XP needed per level
Added ability to raise/lower lighting within the dungeon via in game Options screen

notes.title: Update Notes: 06/02/2022
notes.content:
Minor Update:
Updated Damage dealt as requested by several players.
Added Random monster spawns to increase the difficulty because the Damage has increased.
Added Option (during game play) to the Options menu to adjust the lighting (some reported the dungeon was too dark).
Added more lighting in the darker areas.
